entities.summary: Luz Daniela Gaxiola González is a track cyclist from Mexico. She represented her nation at the 2011, 2013, 2014 and 2015 UCI Track Cycling World Championships. Daniela Gaxiola was a military leaders & commanders from Culiacán (b. 1992-11-25, Culiacán). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to geopolitics.
